name: oido-google-calendar
description: Google Calendar MCP server: events, free/busy, free slots, RSVPs and Meet links (service account over stdio).

settings.name: CALENDAR_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
settings.description: Full content of the Google Cloud service account JSON key file (raw JSON, may have newlines)

settings.name: CALENDAR_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_B64
settings.description: Base64-encoded service account JSON (alternative to CALENDAR_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON, avoids newline issues)

settings.name: CALENDAR_ID
settings.description: Calendar ID to use (default: 'primary' for main calendar). For shared calendars, use the calendar email or ID.

settings.name: CALENDAR_MAX_RESULTS
settings.description: Maximum number of events to return per list/search (default: 20)

settings.name: CALENDAR_TIMEZONE
settings.description: Timezone for event display (e.g. America/New_York, default: system timezone)
